::: {#sol-relu-grad}

Entry $h_k = \maxf{0, z_{1k}}$ depends only on $z_{1k}$,
with derivative 1 where $z_{1k} > 0$
and 0 where $z_{1k} < 0$;
at $z_{1k} = 0$ PyTorch, and these notes,
take it to be 0,
as in [the slopes of the activation functions](feedforward-networks.qmd#sol-activation-slopes).
So

$$
\derivf{\loss}{z_{1k}} = \derivf{\loss}{h_k} \, \indicf{z_{1k} > 0}:
$$

the [gradient](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/linear-regression.html#def-gradient) passes through each [unit](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-unit) that was positive and stops at each unit that was 0.

:::
